Intro: Oh-ho-ho, what is that delectable smell? So much heaven as this I've not felt before!
Now, if you'd strive to indulge me for a spell, I'll not accept less than your finest service at the fore.
So fetch me a [DISH], and let me see your mind at work. For there is no finer way to see the compass one follows down the road.
Success: I see that your spirit has not yet been broken by the murk. You seek to please the many regardless of the load.
Fail: An attempt was made, your duty you did not shirk. But I wonder, will desire alone lead you where you want to go?
Reject: I have to wonder. What drives you: conviction? Curiosity? Or perhaps something more…
